referee_caveats_inferred: Three hosts have S/N 3.5-5, so a single Band 7 point drives their dust SED; deriving SFR of 38-90 Msun/yr from one marginal sub-mm point is fragile
Only one ALMA band (plus Herschel for some) constrains the dust peak; dust temperature is not constrained and CIGALE dust grids are coarse
Reduced chi2 selection is crude: fits with chi2 of 2.3 are adopted while chi2 below 1 are rejected as over-fits, and the number of free parameters vs data points is not given
Reported sensitivity of 0.04/0.02 uJy is implausible (probably mJy) and image rms is never given
Stellar mass and SFR tables contain inconsistent numbers (e.g. GRB050915A SFR 77 vs 76; GRB081221 SFR 56 in Table 11 vs 35 in Table 13 after IMF conversion), complicating answer keys
Comparison with literature SFRs mixes different SED codes, IMF conversions and SFR averaging timescales
